subjectArea: Internal - Multiple Calendar Driving Dimension for Functional Areas

nodes.id: select  source       , driving_dim_code       , module_code       , calendar_type       , activated_indicator from ( select b.pillar_code as source, final.driving_dim_code, null as module_code, '01' as calendar_type, max(show_indicator) as activated_indicator from ( select a.* ,b.*, case when activated_status='SHOW' then 1 else 0 end as show_indicator from (select substr(regexp_replace(sa,'_',' '),4) as sa,activated_status from ( SELECT REPLACE(A.RPD_VAR,'"','') sa,MAX(CASE WHEN A.MODULE_CODE IN (SELECT MODULE_CODE FROM CONTENT_ACTIVATED_MODULES WHERE ACTIVATION_STATUS='Y') THEN 'SHOW' ELSE 'HIDE' END) AS ACTIVATED_STATUS FROM CONTENT_SA_MODULE_MAPPING A WHERE A.MODULE_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY A.RPD_VAR )) a,( select distinct driving_dim_code,regexp_replace(subject_area,'"','') as sa,default_dim_flag from CONTENT_APPSHELL_DRIVING_DIM_SA_MAPPING order by regexp_replace(subject_area,'"','') ) b where  a.sa = b.sa ) final, CONTENT_APPSHELL_DRIVING_DIMS b where final.driving_dim_code = b.driving_dim_code group by final.driving_dim_code,b.pillar_code union select source as source, null as driving_dim_code , null as module_code, calendar_type.calendar_type as calendar_type, max(show_indicator) as activated_indicator from (select a.* , TRIM(substr(a.sa,1,regexp_instr(a.sa,'-')-2)) as module, b.default_dim_flag,coalesce(b.source,'FUSION')as source, case when activated_status='SHOW' then 1 else 0 end as show_indicator from (select substr(regexp_replace(sa,'_',' '),4) as sa,activated_status from ( SELECT REPLACE(A.RPD_VAR,'"','') sa,MAX(CASE WHEN A.MODULE_CODE IN (SELECT MODULE_CODE FROM CONTENT_ACTIVATED_MODULES WHERE ACTIVATION_STATUS='Y') THEN 'SHOW' ELSE 'HIDE' END) AS ACTIVATED_STATUS FROM CONTENT_SA_MODULE_MAPPING A WHERE A.MODULE_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY A.RPD_VAR )) a,( select distinct a.driving_dim_code,regexp_replace(a.subject_area,'"','') as sa,a.default_dim_flag,b.pillar_code as source from CONTENT_APPSHELL_DRIVING_DIM_SA_MAPPING a, CONTENT_APPSHELL_DRIVING_DIMS b where a.driving_dim_code = b.driving_dim_code order by regexp_replace(subject_area,'"','') ) b where a.sa = b.sa(+) order by a.sa ) non_fiscal , (select '02' as calendar_type from dual union select '03' as calendar_type from dual) calendar_type where ((source = 'FUSION' and calendar_type in (2,3)) OR (source = 'NETSUITE' and calendar_type = 2)) group by source,calendar_type.calendar_type ) final
